formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x1.length = (15 : ℕ) → x1.head? = Option.some { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not, inputs := [(4 : ℕ)] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate } → (∀ (x4 : Fin x1.length), (∃ (x5 : ℕ) (x6 : ℕ), x5 ≤ x6 ∧ x6 ≤ (9 : ℕ) + ↑x4 ∧ (x1.get x4 = { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, inputs := [x5, x6] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate } ∨ x1.get x4 = { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, inputs := [x5, x6] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate })) ∨ ∃ x5 ≤ (9 : ℕ) + ↑x4, x1.get x4 = { op := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not, inputs := [x5] : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate }) → ∃ (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), { gates := x1, output := (23 : ℕ) : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit }.eval (List.ofFn x5) ≠ (fun (x6 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => x6 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x6 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x6 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ))) x5
plain_statement: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges) is not computed by a list of exactly 15 gates whose first is NOT x_4, every gate an AND or OR of two wires or a NOT of one wire, reading inputs or wires no later than its own, with the last gate as output.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate NOT x_4 computes its edge function
